title: Making Luck ep. 65 review: Cursed Village, Storeroom, Pillage, Triumph

sources.author: Jake and Wandering Winder
sources.note: Making Luck ep. 65, review of the ep. 64 kingdom, 2:49-18:30; Jake played many games against Adam Horton, Wandering Winder only against bots

quality_note: Jake reports many games against Adam; Wandering Winder adds a partly different read. They agree on the deck and on Triumph and Pillage, differ on opening and Triumph timing, and say more play is needed.

kingdom.setup_notes: Cursed Village is a Doom card, so the Hexes deck is used. Vineyard costs a Potion, so Potion is in the Supply.

edition: Kingdom from Adam Horton's ep. 64 description. Uses first-edition Oracle and Noble Brigand (removed in Hinterlands second edition). Colonies not mentioned.
